name: drawdb
description_en: Free, simple, and intuitive online database diagram editor and SQL generator.
readme_excerpt: drawDB Free, simple, and intuitive database schema editor and SQL generator. DrawDB is a robust and user-friendly database entity relationship diagram (ERD) editor right in your browser. Build diagrams with a few clicks, export and import SQL scripts, generate migrations, customize your editor, and more without creating an account. See the full set of features on here.
